verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report that "Multimodal ... support works as expected" in Ollama's app. That suggests image-plus-text input works, but the pack has no first-party documentation of vision-language models, image input via the API, or which models are supported. The image-generation blog post covers a different capability (creating images, not understanding them) and earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs on vision-model support, API/CLI image-input documentation, a list of supported VLMs, and corroborated depth of image understanding.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
